_: The model files the installed app fetches on its first start, from each
one's own publisher. NOTICE says why none of them is inside the installer:
they are not ours to redistribute.
`tier` decides what happens when one cannot be had. `required` stops the
start with a message and stops a release; `recommended` is logged, the
route that wanted it stays gray in the editor until it can be had, and a
release goes out anyway - a publisher moving a file is not a reason to
hold a version of this app.
`sha256` is the file every measurement in this project was made on, taken
from lee's own copies; a file that arrives different is refused, on the
way in and at release time. `tools/release.py models` fetches every one
of these and says which, if any, no longer matches.
`verified: false` marks a url written from the publisher's naming
convention rather than fetched - Hugging Face is blocked from both the
build sandbox and lee's machine, so the first release is what proves it.
The `models` step names the wrong one if there is one; fix the url here
